data.gender_notes: Kenny is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Variants of the name Kenneth, which is derived from the Old English name Cynweth, meaning 'handsome, attractive', and the Celtic name Coinneach, meaning 'handsome, chief, noble'. The name Kenny carries the meaning “Handsome, attractive” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Kenny usually hope their child will grow to embody handsome, attractive and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the qualities of fairness, friendship, and loyalty.
data.etymology: Kenny belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Handsome, attractive.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kenny total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kenny has been popular throughout history, particularly in Western cultures. It was common among the ancient Celts, Anglo-Saxons, and Picts. In more recent times, the name has been associated with famous figures such as Kenny Rogers, a country music artist, and Kenny Chesney, a contemporary country musician. Kenny also appears as a character in various literature, films, and television shows, contributing to its enduring popularity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Kenny stands as a reminder of the inherent beauty and nobility within every individual, as conveyed in its Old English and Celtic meanings. The beauty in the name continues to inspire and uplift, serving as a spiritual encouragement to those who bear it and to those who come into contact with it. It represents the divine potential within each of God's children, emphasizing the inner qualities of love, compassion, and courage.
